artStyle: Flat vector explainer style (Kurzgesagt-like), simple geometric shapes, clean iconography, no texture.
lighting: Flat, no shading, uniform color fills.
compositionRules: Clear diagrammatic layout, icons/labels legible at small scale, upper third kept clear for captions.
culturalMarkers: Neutral, universally legible iconography — avoid culturally specific imagery unless the topic requires it.
antiArtifactGuidance: Consistent stroke width, no gradient bleed, precise geometric shapes, legible labels.
